turns.question: How many euros more did a social lead cost us than a search lead in September 2026?
turns.answer: In September 2026 (1 to 30 September), cost per lead (EUR) was 52.5 EUR for social and 42.07 EUR (42.06521739130435) for search; the semantic layer has no metric for the gap between channels, so I give both figures rather than a difference I would have to compute myself. Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
